title: Serivisy mazava sy mifanaraka amin’ny filanao.
lead: Misy fomba an-jatony sy iray hanohanana ny iraka ataonay: amin’ny fandraisana anjara, na amin’ny fampiasana ny serivisinay.

cloud.title: Tolotra Cloud
cloud.lead: Tolotra cloud mivelatra mifanaraka amin’ny filanao, natao ho an’ny orinasa kely sy salantsalany.
cloud.supportLead: Raha manana olana amin’ny abonnement ianao: antsoy mivantana ny nomerao:
cloud.supportNote: Ho raisinay ianao raha tsy efa mandray antso ny laharana.
cloud.empty: Ho avy tsy ho ela ny tolotra Cloud.
cloud.detail: Misy tolotra sy faharetana maromaro etsy ambany.
cloud.offersLead: Safidio ny tolotra sy ny faharetana mety amin’ny fikambananao.

enterprise.title: Fanohanana premium sy fanamboarana ONIR-CMS
enterprise.lead: Ny ekipanay no miandraikitra ny fametrahana, fanamboarana ary fanohanana ny instance-nao.

appointment.title: Andao hiresaka ny tetikasanao
appointment.lead: Valio ny fanontaniana vitsivitsy, hiverenanay amin’ny tolo-kevitra mifanaraka aminao.
appointment.note: Hamboarina ao amin’ny WhatsApp na mailaka ny fangatahanao. Tsy misy angona voatahiry amin’ity tranokala ity.

ctaLead: Andao hiresaka ny tetikasanao ary hitady ny safidy mety.

subscription.title: Fangatahana abonnement Cloud
subscription.lead: Fenoy ny mombamomba ny fikambananao sy ny fifandraisana. Hahazo kaody tokana hampiasainao amin’ny famindrana Orange Money na Mvola ianao.
subscription.affiliateInvalid: Tsy mihatra amin’ity tolotra ity io kaody io.
subscription.successLead: Ataovy ny famindrana Mobile Money miaraka amin’ity kaody ity ao amin’ny famaritana. Hisy mpiasa hanamarina ny fandoavam-bola.
subscription.freeSuccessLead: Voatahiry ny fangatahana maimaim-poana. Hojeren’ny mpitantana izy.
subscription.freeInstructions: Tsy misy fandoavam-bola. Havelona ny fidiranao rehefa voamarina.
subscription.fullDefaultMessage: Feno vonjimaika ity tolotra ity. Mifandraisa aminay hahafantarana ny fotoana hisokafany indray.
subscription.noInstructions: Mifandraisa amin’ONIR hahazoana ny antsipirian’ny fandoavam-bola.
subscription.termsUnavailable: Tsy misy ny Fepetra ankapobeny. Mifandraisa amin’ny ONIR-CMS.
subscription.termsRequired: Tsy maintsy ekena ny Fepetra ankapobeny.
subscription.termsChanged: Niova ny Fepetra ankapobeny. Avereno jerena ny pejy.

support.title: Tohano ny IA ho an’ny rehetra.
support.lead: Amin’ny fampiasana ny serivisinay dia manohana ny IA misokatra sy azo idirana ho an’ny fikambanana eto sy any ivelany ianao.

partner.title: Ho lasa mpiara-miombon’antoka
partner.lead: Midira ao amin’ny tontolon’ny ONIR CMS ary amboary miaraka aminay ny assistant mahasoa.

offerDescriptions.FREE: Hahafantaro an’i ONIR CMS miaraka amin’ny chatbot iray sy fetra isam-bolana.
offerDescriptions.STARTER: Hanombohana amin’ny chatbot voalohany sy tokens 1 tapitrisa isam-bolana.
offerDescriptions.BUSINESS: Ho an’ny PME mampiasa chatbots maromaro sy habe matihanina.
offerDescriptions.SCALE: Ho an’ny fikambanana manana habe lehibe sy tranga maromaro.

market.label: Tsena
market.cloudTitle: Ny ONIR CMS Cloud dia misy any Madagasikara ihany aloha
market.cloudLead: Satria tsy mbola manana mpiara-miombon’antoka azo antoka amin’ny fandoavana an-tserasera iraisam-pirenena izahay, voafetra any Madagasikara aloha ny tolotra Cloud. Mikaroka vahaolana ho an’ny fikambanana iraisam-pirenena izahay. Mbola misy ny tolotra Self-hosted, Enterprise ary Partenaire.
